blurb: Level weight 1.0, tilt cap 3.0, crash penalty 300, outward reward peaked at 30 degrees and negative when pointing inward. 100 epochs.

name: run4
title: run4: Rebalanced rewards
blurb: Rebalances rewards so reaching beats standing still: reach 500, crash 100, approach speed scored per 100 px/s. 100 epochs.

name: run3
title: run3: Normalization, 8 envs
blurb: Adds observation and reward normalization, 8 parallel environments (32,768 steps per epoch) and an angular-velocity penalty. 200 epochs.

name: run2

blurb: Adds the level reward. Steps per epoch go from 2048 to 4096 and episodes from 512 to 2048 steps. 100 epochs.

blurb: New runs folder. Separate actor and critic learning rates, the actor rate decays to 0.33x, tilt weight added as an input. 500 epochs.
